programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: New Jersey police working the murder of a woman bludgeoned to death in her own bed first think her boyfriend did it. New Orleans investigators are stumped when a young mother turns up beaten to death, her son gravely injured. The suspects-the husband and his friend-blame each other, so investigators turn to psychic Rosemarie Kerr. Tapping into the fallen wife's vibration, Rosemarie discovers a truth more horrifying than anyone imagined.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Dixon, California, four children wake up one morning to find their mother missing. They turn to their uncle, a seasoned detective, for help. A New Jersey mother wins custody of her three children only to have her ex-husband abduct them and flee. With the help of a detective and psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, she tracks them across the country, but the ex-husband is always one step ahead - putting Nancy's visions to the test.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Oklahoma, an unexpected storm turns a family camping trip into a nightmare, as a flooded creek rips two children from their mother's arms. When another body surfaces a month later, police turn to psychic Ann Fisher who predicts that the killer will strike again and again. Can she help police stop this madman before he finds his next victim?

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A woman vanishes in Oregon, leaving her infant daughter behind.
